findings.claim: The customer-read exclusion remains bypassable through global search. Order detail also exposes billing addresses and phone numbers beyond D9's stated email/shipping exception.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:54,327 permits search while excluding customers. packages/api/src/routes/admin-reports.ts:129-146 returns customer identities independently of orders. packages/api/src/routes/admin.ts:194,210 returns customer phone and billingAddress.
findings.fix: Remove search from AGENT_READS or redact customer results for agents. Redact additional order PII or explicitly revise the accepted scope. Test customers without orders.

findings.claim: The duplicate-route assertion necessarily rejects ordinary OpenAPI routes: app.routes contains separate entries for validators and the terminal handler sharing the same method/path. matchedRoutes is populated before next(), preserves wildcard registration paths, and includes the terminal handler; filtering wildcard entries handles trailing wildcard middleware, but the proposed inventory does not prove terminal-route uniqueness.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:425,483-492. packages/api/node_modules/@hono/zod-openapi/dist/index.mjs:94-164 registers middleware, validators and handler together. packages/api/node_modules/hono/dist/hono-base.js:55-62,264-271 stores each handler separately; :284-305 computes matches before dispatch. packages/api/node_modules/hono/dist/request.js:265-266 exposes the complete match. Existing packages/api/src/sdk/route-inventory.ts:35-40 deliberately deduplicates entries. Registration-order semantics: [Hono routing](https://hono.dev/docs/api/routing#routing-priority).
findings.fix: Validate operation registrations separately from their validator chains. Deduplicate for capability existence checks; detect competing terminal registrations through explicit registration metadata. Cover trailing wildcard middleware and overlapping plugin routes.

findings.claim: The proposed tripwire fails against v4 itself. It conflates unrelated resource fields and even comments: allowed stock items, blog tags and fulfillment lines all occur in coupon-context.ts.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:344,346-358,489,499. packages/api/src/money/coupon-context.ts:15,24 contains tags, :37 mentions CouponContext.items, and :41-44 contains lines.
findings.fix: Check qualified resource fields and actual promotion dependencies. Distinguish product.tags from blog.tags; do not treat comment words or unrelated array names as promotion dependencies.

findings.claim: Content-Length is not proof of body absence. A body without that header passes NONE capabilities. The proposed DELETE body-smuggling test itself supplies no Content-Length and therefore cannot receive the expected policy 403.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:430 defaults missing content-length to zero; :869 sends a body without that header. packages/api/node_modules/hono/dist/hono-base.js:346-355 passes requestInit into Request without adding Content-Length. packages/api/src/routes/admin-reviews.ts:76-95 declares only parameter validation and ignores the body.
findings.fix: Inspect actual body bytes with a bounded presence check for NONE capabilities. Test absent, zero and positive Content-Length, plus bodies without the header. Preserve multipart handling.

findings.claim: The success suite cannot pass: partial fulfillment sends lines:[], which fails validation. The fixture contains no order lines, and full fulfillment precedes partial fulfillment on the same order.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:741-746,775-776,782,838. packages/api/src/routes/admin.ts:371 requires at least one line; :309-313 fulfills remaining quantities; :415-418 rejects foreign or exhausted lines.
findings.fix: Seed real lines and independent orders for full, partial and bulk fulfillment. Assert persisted fulfillment quantities, stock changes and bulk item outcomes.

findings.claim: The denial test executes successful owner mutations against the same fixtures and then requires table counts to remain unchanged. Variant, collection, promotion, staff and agent creation invalidate that assertion. Both branches of the expected-count ternary add zero.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:791-806,849-857. packages/api/src/routes/admin-catalog.ts:107-142 inserts variants; packages/api/src/routes/admin-settings-advanced.ts:174-186 creates staff; plan:605-611 creates an agent for the owner control.
findings.fix: Compare state immediately before and after each agent request. Run successful human controls against separately reset fixtures.

findings.claim: Owner status !=403 accepts validation errors, missing resources and server failures. The license control lacks required fields; the bulk-cancel control targets a paid order that is deliberately skipped. Per-capability persisted effects and release-registration denial remain untested.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:746,799,801,838-843,854-855. packages/api/src/routes/admin-licenses.ts:15-27 requires appKey and reason. packages/api/src/routes/admin-order-ops.ts:524 rejects paid orders within the batch. Plan:785-816 contains no release-registration request.
findings.fix: Require valid successful human controls, including successful batch items. Add release registration, persisted effects for every capability, and money/entitlement state snapshots rather than selected table counts alone.

findings.claim: Updating the route golden file alone leaves pnpm verify failing. New routes and /me fields change both committed storefront-client contract artifacts, which the plan omits.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:62-82,469,936. package.json:13 runs storefront-client generate:check. packages/storefront-client/scripts/generate.mts:46-55 generates the complete contract; :68-79 compares openapi.json and src/generated/schema.d.ts.
findings.fix: Add and regenerate packages/storefront-client/openapi.json and packages/storefront-client/src/generated/schema.d.ts through the existing command. Update the route golden count as well as its five entries, and include generated changes in the budget.

findings.claim: The e2e throws before opening Staff because AdminApi.post already returns parsed JSON. Its Description locator also cannot match the existing unassociated label.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:1049 calls .json() on api.post's result; :1069 uses getByLabel('Description'). packages/admin/e2e/support/api.ts:35-45 returns parsed JSON. packages/admin/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx:153 supplies no htmlFor; packages/admin/src/components/ui-forms.tsx:46-52 renders label and control as siblings.
findings.fix: Use api.post<{id:string}> directly, use the existing field() fixture helper, and re-fetch the product to assert the persisted description.

findings.claim: The revised guarantee still claims transactional entity audits that do not exist. Allowed asset creation/deletion and blog update/deletion can commit without any actor-attributed audit if the best-effort middleware audit fails.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:440 suppresses audit errors; :469 specifies guard swaps only; :1117 claims transactional entity audits. packages/api/src/routes/admin-assets.ts:64-66,101-126 and packages/api/src/routes/admin-content.ts:110-121,136 contain mutations without audit insertion.
findings.fix: Add entity audits inside these mutation transactions and verify rollback on audit failure, or explicitly narrow the guarantee to acknowledge unaudited committed mutations.

findings.claim: Permitted operations contradict the stated email/IndexNow exclusion. Fulfillment sends shipping notifications; catalog edits emit events that can trigger IndexNow.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:318-319,1114 excludes these effects. packages/api/src/routes/admin.ts:333-344,451-458 enqueues shipping notifications. packages/api/src/routes/admin-products.ts:128 invokes the catalog emitter; packages/api/src/webhooks/catalog.ts:20 emits catalog.product_changed; packages/storefront/src/services/indexnow-webhook.server.ts:40-50 submits IndexNow. Deployed webhook configuration is unverified.
findings.fix: Specify bounded shipping notifications and configured catalog hooks as permitted consequences, or suppress them for agents. Test whichever policy is chosen.

findings.claim: The plan exceeds its own file stop-loss before implementation begins: the file map names 43 files, but max_files is 34. Existing principal-test edits, the baseline receipt and missing generated artifacts increase that total. The 420-minute estimate also lacks the required code-rate inputs and named non-typing allocations.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:62-82 lists 43 files including the two .test.ts shorthand entries; :84 caps files at 34; :88 adds a receipt; :264 requires existing test edits. Supplied Workspace Rules require file/line/code-rate inputs and named non-typing minutes.
findings.fix: Reconcile scope and ceilings before execution and derive the elapsed schedule from explicit inputs. Default to the current checkout/main; D10's branch alternative requires Adrian's explicit authorization.

findings.claim: The policy advertises slug as editable, but the handler never updates it. A slug-only patch returns 400.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/2026-10-10-agent-role.md:347 allows slug. packages/api/src/routes/admin-content.ts:114-118 excludes slug from the update and rejects an empty patch.
findings.fix: Remove slug from the PATCH capability unless renaming is separately specified and implemented.
